title: Wiki: Important Systems
summary: Read the Wiki signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Articles and collections provide written guidance. Guide books are physical manuals. Related links can bridge into Index when the needed addon is present.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch article categories, guide-book shelves, collection order, related links, dynamic pages, and whether optional addon content is visible in this pack.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Wiki system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
